entries.text:
A reviewer (GPT-6.1-Sol) checked your 7 commits at 0e01fd1 and verified the findings below. Meanwhile another agent built on your work: the checkout is now on branch feat/headless-ledger (6 more commits, including src/core/rolloutThread.ts and changes near rollout.ts). Create branch fix/codex-review from feat/headless-ledger and fix all four findings there at the root cause, each with a test that reproduces the reviewer's failing input first. Re-check against real rollouts as before (server on PORT=4781; 4777 and 4779 are taken by other servers, never touch them). Same verification and commit rules as before. Report commits and verification.


── assistant · 29m ago
Four verified defects at `0e01fd1`. All affect the displayed session history.

- **P2: The merge drops separate web actions that use the same query or URL.** [src/core/codex.ts:221](./src/core/codex.ts:221)
  - Failing input: `thread/read` contains search `ws1` for `"effect schema"`. The rollout contains a later search `ws2` for the same query. Only `ws1` remains. An `open_page` also removes a later `find_in_page` for that URL.
  - What I'd do here is match individual calls by ID. Where IDs differ, match one occurrence using the action type, arguments, and position. A query or URL alone cannot identify a call.

  ```text
  Search ws1 + later search ws2 → only ws1
  ```

- **P2: A failed command inside a completed script shows as `ok`.** [src/core/rollout.ts:403](./src/core/rollout.ts:403)
  - Failing input: script `text(await tools.exec_command({cmd: "pnpm test"}));`, followed by `Script completed\nOutput:\n{"exit_code":1,"output":"1 test failed"}`. With no nested item from `thread/read`, the viewer shows `pnpm test` as `ok`, with no exit code.
  - The code checks whether the script failed. It does not check the command result. Decode known command result shapes with Schema and preserve their exit codes. Keep a script action when command status cannot be recovered.

  ```text
  Command exits 1 → script completes → command shown as ok
  ```

- **P2: Initial output marks a running command as successful.** [src/core/rollout.ts:342](./src/core/rollout.ts:342)
  - Failing input: `exec_command` runs `pnpm build` and returns `Process running with session ID 41\nOutput:\nbuilding\n`. The viewer shows `ok` while the turn is active. It also shows `ok` after an interrupted turn with no final result.
  - The fix is to track completion separately from output. A session or cell ID means the call is still running. Set the final status when its continuation finishes or the turn is interrupted.

  ```text
  Partial output + session ID → outputs.length > 0 → ok
  ```

- **P2: An escaped quote in a substitution hides later command parts.** [src/core/shell.ts:167](./src/core/shell.ts:167)
  - Failing input: `TOKEN=[redacted] "a\"b") && git push`. This is valid shell syntax. `humanizeCommand` returns `[]`; the parser treats the rest of the command as part of the assignment.
  - `indexOf` treats the escaped quote as the closing quote. What I'd do here is scan quoted text with escape handling, then resume substitution parsing at the correct position.

  ```text
  Escaped quote → wrong closing quote → git push swallowed
  ```

The three focused test files pass: **19 tests**. The inputs above reproduce failures those tests do not cover. A synthetic 53 MB rollout with 5,000 calls scanned in about **121 ms**. I found no verified serious performance or catastrophic regex issue. The checkout stayed unchanged.
